name: Memory LanceDB
description: OpenClaw LanceDB-backed long-term memory plugin with auto-recall, auto-capture, and vector search.

embedding.apiKey.label: Embedding API Key
embedding.apiKey.help: Optional API key override for OpenAI-compatible embeddings; omit to use configured provider auth

embedding.provider.label: Embedding Provider
embedding.provider.help: Memory embedding provider adapter to use (for example openai, github-copilot, ollama)

embedding.baseUrl.label: Base URL
embedding.baseUrl.help: Optional provider or OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint base URL

embedding.dimensions.label: Dimensions
embedding.dimensions.help: Vector dimensions for custom models (required for non-standard models)

reranker.model.label: Reranker Model
reranker.model.help: Optional OpenAI-compatible chat model used to rerank vector search candidates

reranker.apiKey.label: Reranker API Key
reranker.apiKey.help: Optional API key override for reranking; falls back to the embedding API key

reranker.baseUrl.label: Reranker Base URL
reranker.baseUrl.help: Optional OpenAI-compatible base URL for reranking; falls back to the embedding base URL

reranker.timeoutMs.label: Reranker Timeout
reranker.timeoutMs.help: Maximum time to wait for a reranker response

reranker.maxCandidates.label: Reranker Candidates
reranker.maxCandidates.help: Maximum number of vector candidates to send to the reranker

reranker.maxDocumentChars.label: Reranker Document Chars
reranker.maxDocumentChars.help: Maximum characters per candidate passed to the reranker

autoCapture.label: Auto-Capture
autoCapture.help: Automatically capture important information from conversations

autoRecall.label: Auto-Recall
autoRecall.help: Automatically inject relevant memories into context

dreaming.label: Dreaming
dreaming.help: Optional dreaming config consumed when this plugin owns the memory slot

captureMaxChars.label: Capture Max Chars
captureMaxChars.help: Maximum message length eligible for auto-capture

customTriggers.label: Custom Triggers
customTriggers.help: Literal phrases that should make auto-capture consider a message memory-worthy

recallMaxChars.label: Recall Query Max Chars
recallMaxChars.help: Maximum prompt/query length embedded for memory recall. Lower for small local embedding models.

storageOptions.label: Storage Options
storageOptions.help: Storage configuration options (access_key, secret_key, endpoint, etc.); supports ${ENV_VAR} values
